notes.title: 10/10/2024 bug fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
Based on player feedback and suggestions, we have fixed some issues present in the game.

Fixed:
The game crashes after launching

notes.title: Version 1.2.5.26 Update
notes.content:
Updates and Fixes:

Further reduced the difficulty level in Easy mode.

Optimized text effects in story dialogues.

notes.title: Version 1.1.5.25 Update
notes.content:
Updates and Fixes:

During the bartending process, characters' skills will only be activated at fixed times.

The judgment area for handing out flyers has been expanded, and the visual effects have been optimized.

Fixed some dialog text errors in Free Mode.

Difficulty selection in the game has been moved to appear when starting a new game.
